content.description:
A black something appeared in the Wuhan laboratory. It has permeated the whole world. "Divide et impera" - Gaius Iulius Caesar. And the world was divided into small pieces of land. Hostile factions have formed on these pieces of land.

They are at war with each other. They are killing each other. While something is just gaining strength. This black shit keeps taking over the world. And only your skills and weapons can help you survive.
